description_en: Binds a multi-factor authentication (MFA) device to a Resource Access Management (RAM) user
description_zh: 为RAM用户绑定指定的多因素认证设备
name: BindMFADevice

parameters.help_en:
The serial number of the MFA device.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/186179.html operation to obtain the serial number of the MFA device
parameters.help_zh:
多因素认证设备的序列号。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/186179.html获取多因素认证设备的序列号
parameters.name: serial_number

parameters.help_en: The logon name of the RAM user
parameters.name: user_principal_name

parameters.help_en:
The first verification code.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/186179.html operation to create an MFA device and generate a key (value of `Base32StringSeed`). Then, use the key on the Alibaba Cloud app to manually add an MFA device, and obtain the two consecutive verification codes
parameters.help_zh:
第一组安全验证码。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/186179.html创建多因素认证设备并生成密钥（0的值），然后使用该密钥在移动端阿里云应用中手动添加多因素认证设备，最后获取连续的两组安全验证码
parameters.name: authentication_code_1

parameters.help_en:
The second verification code.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/186179.html operation to create an MFA device and generate a key (value of `Base32StringSeed`). Then, use the key on the Alibaba Cloud app to manually add an MFA device, and obtain the two consecutive verification codes
parameters.help_zh:
第二组安全验证码。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/186179.html创建多因素认证设备并生成密钥（0的值），然后使用该密钥在移动端阿里云应用中手动添加多因素认证设备，最后获取连续的两组安全验证码
parameters.name: authentication_code_2
